subject: A link for your Useful Links page
body:
Hi there,

Your team receives our referral newsletter, and your Advanced Weight Loss Services page lists sleeve gastrectomy, gastric bypass and revision surgery. Those are the patients we see most: people who need a psychological evaluation before surgery and behavioral support after it. We see patients from the Valley by telehealth, anywhere in Texas.

Would you add us to your Useful Links page (https://www.texasdigestive.com/useful-links/)? The page we suggest is our bariatric surgery psychological evaluation page, https://www.bariatriccounselingcenter.com/bariatric-surgery-psychological-evaluation-in-san-antonio-tx/, with the link text "Bariatric surgery psychological evaluation (telehealth across Texas)".

In return we will list Texas Digestive Specialists as a referral partner on our website, and we can produce a co-branded printable handout for your patients, "What to expect in the psychological evaluation", with your logo next to ours.

If someone else looks after the website, I would be grateful if you could pass this along.

Todd McCord
Bariatric Counseling Center, San Antonio
www.bariatriccounselingcenter.com
